assumptions: One task, two writers and tenants, versions 1..6, clock 0..4, three history elements and two import fingerprints.
CAS retries, expiry and deletion, owner filtering and pre-serving idempotent import are modeled.

Arbitrary unconditional replacement, the Redis backend and semantic task status transitions are excluded. Ten real SQLite-backed workerd checks cover selected receipt and content-preservation scenarios, not general trace equivalence.
A foreign read is rejected before the owned import phase closes, matching the Durable Object transaction.

History is set-valued in this model. Real implementation checks assert ordered complete content and duplicate retention. Multi-task import conflict atomicity is checked by workerd outside the one-task model.
bounds.progress: No temporal or fairness claim. Each model permits stuttering and repeated failures.
